annotations.title: Claim an item on an Event guest link

description: For a guest: claim something to bring on a Just List Event, using the guest link the host sent and the guest's first name — exactly what the guest page allows. Pass the item's text as shown on the Event. If the item is not found, the reply lists what is still open.

firstName.description: The guest's first name, shown to the host and other guests

item.description: The item to claim, as written on the Event

quantity.description: How many of it the guest brings (default 1)
